### ✨ Baseball Superstars Mod Menu (v35.4.7)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Boost Ally Primary Stats** — Multiplies Strength, Intellect, Agility & Spirit for MyTeam players
- **Primary Stat Multiplier** — Scales PrimaryStatsManager.GetStatsValue & GetStatsOutValue
- **Boost Ally Secondary Stats** — Multiplies all 13 pitching, batting & fielding stats for MyTeam
- **Secondary Stat Multiplier** — Scales SecondaryStatsManager.GetStatsValue (20001-20013)
- **Max Ally Condition (Best Condition)** — Locks PlayerBaseInfo & Classic Condition at 5 (Max)
- **Infinite MyLeague Skill Points (9,999 SP)** — Locks MyLeaguePlayerInfo.get_SkillPoint at >= 9,999
- **100% Training Success (Never Fail)** — Forces IsFailable = false, SuccessProb = 100% & TrainingShield active
- **0 Stamina Cost Training** — Forces TrainingFormula.CostStamina & DefaultCostStamina = 0
- **Training Stat Gain Multiplier** — Multiplies STR, INT, AGI, SPI, SP, Credit & Mana gained from training
- **Max Training Feeling Gain** — Boosts TrainingFormula.GainableFeeling to maximum (+5)
- **Weaken Enemy Stats** — Reduces all Enemy Primary & Secondary stats in match & simulation
- **Enemy Stat Scale** — Percentage of original stats kept by Enemy (0% = 1 stat)
- **Drain Enemy Pitcher Stamina (0 Stamina)** — Forces Enemy Pitcher StaminaInfo.Current to 0 immediately
- **Infinite Ally Pitcher Stamina** — Locks MyTeam Pitcher StaminaInfo.Current at 100% Total
- **Enemy Always Out / StrikeOut** — Forces Enemy batters to GroundOut (live) or StrikeOut (simulation)
- **Freeze Enemy Score at 0** — Blocks Enemy team from scoring & returns 0 for AITeamScore
- **Always Home Run (MyTeam Live & Sim)** — Forces MyTeam hits to Home Run in live batting & simulation
- **Perfect Swing Timing (MyTeam)** — Forces Batter.IsPerfectSwingTiming = true when MyTeam is batting
- **Add +5 Runs to Current Attack Team** — Calls MatchManager.Instance.AddScore(5, true)
- **2 Strikes / 0 Balls (Instant Strikeout Setup)** — Sets count to 0 Balls, 2 Strikes via MatchManager
- **Force 3 Outs (End Half-Inning)** — Calls MatchManager.Instance.SetOutCount(3, false)
- **Game Speed (Time.timeScale)** — Scales UnityEngine.Time.set_timeScale (1.0x - 5.0x)
- **Target Frame Rate (FPS)** — Sets UnityEngine.Application.targetFrameRate

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
